stdout:
name: One-shot Actions App token native rebase capability

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - exh-1109-causal-rb-app-001/runner

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: exh-1109-causal-rb-app-001-one-shot
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  capability:
    if: >-
      github.repository == 'joshlf/gherrit-native-stack-experiments-2026-11-08' &&
      github.actor == 'joshlf' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' &&
      github.event.created == true &&
      github.event.deleted == false &&
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/exh-1109-causal-rb-app-001/runner' &&
      github.run_attempt == 1
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 4
    steps:
      - name: Checkout only the exact triggering source
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 1
      - name: One guarded PUT without retries
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PROBE_CONFIG_SHA256: 8a5eed309e1d98d5c9ac559fb7f05ce70f6886f3527cd963d02df629b9d31ac3
        shell: bash
        run: python3 probe.py fixture.json evidence
      - name: Retain only sanitized probe files
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: exh-1109-causal-rb-app-001-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: evidence/*.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
          include-hidden-files: false
